commands.step: release.yml rehearsal STATUS must be recorded
commands.text:
set -eu
# Header STATUS comment only — not this step's own error text.
if grep -E -q '^[[:space:]]*#[[:space:]]*STATUS:[[:space:]]*NOT YET RUN\b' .github/workflows/release.yml; then
  echo "::error::release.yml header STATUS is still unset; rehearse before the next live release."
  echo "::error::gh workflow run release.yml --ref <tag-carrying-actions> -f rehearse=true"

fi

fi

fi

commands.step: The version in the tag must equal the version in the package
The two workflows must read the same visibility
commands.text:
case "$REPOSITORY_IS_PRIVATE" in
  true)
    echo "::notice::repository is PRIVATE; the npm job publishes without provenance."
    ;;
  false)
    echo "::notice::repository is PUBLIC; the npm job publishes with provenance."
    ;;
  *)
    echo "::error::github.event.repository.private read as '${REPOSITORY_IS_PRIVATE:-<empty>}', which is neither true nor false."
    echo "::error::Both publish jobs branch on this fact; refusing before either registry is reached."
    exit 1
    ;;
esac

commands.step: A pre-release must not reach either registry
commands.text:
case "$GITHUB_EVENT_NAME" in
  release)
    case "$RELEASE_IS_PRERELEASE" in
      false)
        echo "::notice::the release is not a pre-release; both publish jobs may run."
        ;;
      true)
        echo "::error::this release is marked PRE-RELEASE, and the step that reaches the registry carries no --tag, so npm would move the latest dist-tag onto it for every user of @mcptoolshop/armature-studio."
        echo "::error::This studio publishes no pre-release channel. Refusing before either registry is reached; unmark the release, or cut a normal version."
        exit 1
        ;;
      *)
        echo "::error::github.event.release.prerelease read as '${RELEASE_IS_PRERELEASE:-<empty>}', which is neither true nor false."
        echo "::error::This gate decides whether the publish fork may run; refusing rather than guessing."
        exit 1
        ;;
    esac
    ;;
  *)
    echo "::notice::$GITHUB_EVENT_NAME carries no release object, so there is no pre-release flag to read; the tag gate above is what constrains this arrival."
    ;;
esac
# REHEARSAL STATUS (same step, not a fourth gate — tests pin exactly three pure-shell
# gates in verify). A live release:published refuses while the header STATUS line
# is unset (NOT YET RUN), marked STALE after a gate-set change, or still names the
# pre-pip-audit rehearsal id 34073888719. Match only that comment line, never this
# script's needle. On workflow_dispatch the obligation notices and continues so a
# fresh proof can clear the line. ci.yml carries the same STATUS check so the debt
# is CI-reachable before a tag is cut.
case "$GITHUB_EVENT_NAME" in
  release)
    if grep -E -q '^[[:space:]]*#[[:space:]]*STATUS:[[:space:]]*NOT YET RUN\b' .github/workflows/release.yml; then
      echo "::error::release.yml header STATUS is still unset; a live release must not be the first execution of this workflow's gates."
      echo "::error::Rehearse first: gh workflow run release.yml --ref <tag> -f rehearse=true — then record the run id and tag on the STATUS line."
      exit 1
    fi
    if grep -E -q '^[[:space:]]*#[[:space:]]*STATUS:[[:space:]]*STALE\b' .github/workflows/release.yml; then
      echo "::error::release.yml header STATUS is STALE; the recorded rehearsal predates a later gate-set change (e.g. pip-audit)."
      echo "::error::Re-dispatch: gh workflow run release.yml --ref <tag-carrying-actions> -f rehearse=true — then rewrite STATUS: RUN <id> ..."
      exit 1
    fi
    if grep -E -q '^[[:space:]]*#[[:space:]]*STATUS:[[:space:]]*RUN[[:space:]]+34073888719\b' .github/workflows/release.yml; then
      echo "::error::release.yml STATUS still names pre-pip-audit rehearsal 34073888719; that run never exercised audit Python dependencies."
      echo "::error::Re-dispatch after pip-audit and rewrite STATUS with the new run id."
      exit 1
    fi
    echo "::notice::STATUS is recorded and fresh; live release may proceed past the rehearsal obligation."
    ;;
  *)
    echo "::notice::$GITHUB_EVENT_NAME is not release: published; STATUS obligation applies to a live release only."
    ;;
esac

NAME=$(node -p "require('./package.json').name")
VER=$(node -p "require('./package.json').version")
# THE PROBE KEEPS BOTH ANSWERS. It was
# `if npm view "$NAME@$VER" version >/dev/null 2>&1; then` — both streams to
# /dev/null, branching on the exit code alone — and `npm view` exits 1 for
# `this version is not on the registry` (E404) AND for `this job could not ask`.
# Measured on `e8263a3` with no external egress:
# `npm view @mcptoolshop/armature-studio@0.3.0 version --registry=http://127.0.0.1:1/`
# exits 1 with `npm error code ECONNREFUSED`, the same code an E404 produces, and
# driving this step's own `if` shape over a transport failure and over an E404 took
# the SAME branch — fall through to `npm publish` — with the reason discarded in
# both. So a re-run of a release whose npm publish had already succeeded would meet
# a registry blip here, publish, and be refused a version that already exists: the
# job turns red for having already succeeded, which is the outcome the comment
# above says this step exists to prevent, with nothing in the log naming the
# probe's failure.
#
# Only an E404 means "not published". Anything else is a refusal that halts with
# the registry's own message. The verdict is echoed either way.
VIEW_CODE=0
VIEW=$(npm view "$NAME@$VER" version 2>&1) || VIEW_CODE=$?
if [ "$VIEW_CODE" = "0" ]; then
  echo "::notice::$NAME@$VER is already on the registry (npm view answered '$VIEW') — nothing to publish."
elif case "$VIEW" in *E404*) false ;; *) true ;; esac; then
  echo "::error::npm view $NAME@$VER exited $VIEW_CODE and the answer was not an E404, so this job cannot tell 'not published' from 'could not ask'."
  echo "::error::$VIEW"
  echo "::error::Refusing rather than publishing on an unanswered probe; publishing is the one step here with no compensator."
  exit 1
else
  echo "::notice::$NAME@$VER: the registry answered E404 — not on the registry, so this run publishes."
  if [ "$REPOSITORY_IS_PRIVATE" = "false" ]; then
    echo "::notice::$NAME@$VER: repository is public — publishing WITH provenance."
    npm publish --provenance --access public
  elif [ "$REPOSITORY_IS_PRIVATE" = "true" ]; then
    echo "::notice::$NAME@$VER: repository is private — publishing WITHOUT provenance."
    npm publish --access public
  else
    echo "::error::github.event.repository.private read as '${REPOSITORY_IS_PRIVATE:-<empty>}'; refusing to publish on a visibility this job could not read."
    exit 1
  fi
fi
